items.summary: Financial recommendation: approve the narrow reassignment of the overdue capacity-reconciliation work to principal-engineer, but reject admission of the totaljerks.com CTA change this cycle. The 2026-09-21 revenue window shows 453 Amazon clicks and 0 site-attributed ordered items; the aggregate $4.92 commission cannot support site revenue, ROI, contribution margin, or upside claims. Existing telemetry records 52 sessions and 1 conversion, but CTA attribution and causal lift are not evidenced. Retain no-spend planning only until capacity is reconciled and an existing CTA event or equivalent measurement is confirmed. Contribution margin, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn remain not calculable because direct infrastructure, domain, labor/time, budget, and site-level revenue allocation are unavailable. Minimum measurement: registered tracking ID mapped to site/content, existing CTA-event counts, direct cost by change/site, and implementation effort/time. created_by=cfo.
